title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(小野慎研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Ono Shin)
educationalGoal: Understand basic specialized knowledge of chemistry, and apply to problem setting and problem solving. Search the literature on PD3 research themes. Make a research plan and carry out the research (experiment / analysis). Summarize research results, produce reports and present them.
advice: 1. Understand the basics of organic chemistry, polymer chemistry, biochemistry, and enzyme chemistry, and use them to carry out research. 2. Review the literature and discuss with other researchers about your research theme as appropriate. 3. Contribute to the local community by actively participating in joint research with companies, and grasp the needs of research in the real world. Seminars are held at least once a week. The seminar will introduce literature, report on project activities, and analyze and present experimental results.
books: Textbooks is not specified. Reference books: Introduction to peptide science (Ian W. Hamley ed., Wiley), Peptide conjugation (Waleed M. Hussein; Rachel J. Stephenson; Istvan Toth ed., Humana Press), Polypeptide materials (Maxim G. Ryadnov ed., Humana Press)
requiredKnowledge: Understand a wide range of basic knowledge in the field of chemistry, especially in the fields related to life sciences. Regarding experiments, understand how to handle instruments and devices learned in safety education.
